$comment: Applicability for the statutory report catalogue (docs/25 §8.3, stories/12 ANA-005, stories/13 COMPL-001). Counts and due dates are the owner decisions cited on each entry. form_status verify_at_load means a draft may be listed and filing is refused. This file is not a government form. A due date that is absent here is not invented. requirements/13 mentions 100 employees for federal employment equity; docs/25 §8.3 does not use that count as a gate.
